note: Floors are per split, in execution accuracy percent, taken as the minimum observed across the recent runs on Mini-Dev (G 9120c2b, H d5927b0, I 700529b, J 4ad0181, 1.0.0 run 39762058351, and the 13-arm runs since), applied to the full 500-question split. A rerun may land below a floor by tolerancePp before the gate fails, because ADR-166 measured that anything inside 4pp cannot be separated from sampling noise at n=239. `inline+retrieval`, `inline+icl`, `inline+repair`, `inline+repair-raw`, `select`, `select5` and `values` were added to the chain after those runs and have no floors yet: the gate records their first measurement and says so rather than inventing a threshold. A run scored on fewer than 95% of the baseline sample fails as a changed sample. `armsBySplit` states which arms each split runs; the dev split compares against a published leaderboard and needs three arms, not thirteen, and applying Mini-Dev's list to it failed the first dev run.
